scripts.dev: bash -c 'if [ -s "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" ]; then source "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh"; nvm use 20 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"'
scripts.test: bash -c 'if [ -s "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" ]; then source "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh"; nvm use 20 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; vitest run'
scripts.check: bash -c 'if [ -s "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" ]; then source "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh"; nvm use 20 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test'
